types.title: Leave types
types.intro: The tenant's leave types: annual leave, personal leave, SI sick and maternity leave…
types.seedConfirm: Create the VN statutory leave types the tenant does not have yet?
types.seedResult: {created, number} leave types created; {existing, number} already existed.
types.attendanceCodeHint: A LEAVE attendance code shown on the timesheet.
types.categoriesHint: Empty = every category. Type codes separated by commas.

policies.title: Leave policies
policies.intro: Entitlement, accrual, seniority leave and carry-over per leave type, legal entity and employee category. Never below the statutory floor.
policies.carryValue: up to {days} days, expires after {months} months
policies.accrualHint: Default: monthly for balance-tracked types, otherwise none.
policies.baseHint: Annual leave: empty = the statutory floor (12/14/16 days).

requests.title: Leave requests
requests.intro: Leave requests in your data scope.
requests.attachmentsHint: Type the ids of documents uploaded to the document library, Enter after each.
requests.attachmentRequired: This leave type needs a supporting document.

si.title: SI claim data
si.certificateTypeRequired: The SI certificate type is required.
si.certificateTypeHint: E.g. SI sick-leave certificate, discharge paper, birth certificate
si.childBirthDateRequired: Child sick leave needs the child's birth date.
si.replaceWarning: You cannot see the current values; saving replaces the whole SI claim data.

detail.title: Leave request
detail.earlyReturnTitle: Return before the end of maternity leave
detail.earlyReturnHint: The employee has taken the statutory minimum and has a medical confirmation.

balances.title: Leave balances
balances.intro: Balances per leave type and year, the leave ledger, adjustments and the termination settlement.
balances.selectEmployee: Select an employee to see the leave balances.
balances.adjustHint: Each adjustment is a ledger row (never edited or deleted) and needs a reason.

settlement.atLwd: Computed at the last working day {date}.
settlement.projection: No termination yet: projected as of today.
settlement.finaliseHint: Writes the encash / recover rows to the ledger; Payroll computes the amounts.

jobs.title: Accrual & year-end
jobs.intro: Run leave accrual, year-end carry-over and carry expiry. The nightly job runs them too; re-running never writes twice.

accrual.title: Monthly accrual
accrual.hint: Writes the month's accrual (Decree 145: half a month or more counts as a month).

yearEnd.title: Year-end carry-over
yearEnd.hint: Carries the remaining days into the next year up to the policy limit; the rest is forfeited, encashed or flagged.

expiry.title: Carry expiry
expiry.hint: Applies the policy's expiry action to carried days past their expiry date.

result.title: Run result
result.summary: {run}: {employments, number} employments, {written, number} written, {skipped, number} skipped, {failed, number} failed.

warning.eligibility-gender-unverified: The gender eligibility could not be verified; the approver should check it.
